plan.idea: 在本风格验证日用预测与 H5 十档标签的日截面 Spearman 均值选轮，消除股票代码在早停中的作用，并检验各专家的 Top3×H5 净年化与夏普是否均高于 v5。
plan.selection_rule: Each style must pass tie check and both own-style official ensemble net_ann and net_sharpe strictly exceed the frozen v5 on the identical dates. RankIC supplementary. If any passes, backtest with v5 fallback for all unqualified styles. All four reported separately.
